newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan gives US corp new issue engine lube job.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan gives US corp new issue engine lube job.

text.p: Tuesday's bond market rally sparked by comments from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan will likely grease the engine of the U.S. corporate bond primary market for the remainder of the week, syndicate sources said.
"Obviously, with this type of a market rally, some opportunistic issuers are going to appear," said one dealer.

High-grade issuers rumored to be preparing deals include Morgan Stanley Group with $300 million in five-year debt, HomeSide Inc with a $200 million seven-year issue and Becton Dickinson & Co with a $200 million 30-year bullet deal.
After a brief pause yesterday, the primary market for junk bonds is also expected to see more activity starting Wednesday.
"Conditions in the junk bond (primary) market are still very robust," said one junk bond official. "The recent rally further confirms that the environment is perfect for new issuance"

On deck for today is Riverwood International Corp's $250 million 144a offering of 10-year senior notes via Chase Securities. Price talk on the B3/B-minus offering is 10.625-10.75 percent, market sources said.
Riverwood, based in Atlanta, Georgia, manufactures food and consumer goods packaging.
Up to four emerging market deals may be priced in the U.S. as early as Wednesday, syndicate officials confirmed.
Morgan Stanley will revive a $350 million Eurobond/144a offering from Espirito Santo Centrais Eletricas SA (ESCLESA) a Brazilian utility.
Price talk has been boosted by roughly 50 basis points after the deal was postponed last week due to volatility in the markets for Brazilian securities.
Talk on the offering (B1/BB-minus) is now a spread range of 400-425 basis points over Treasuries, up from last week's levels of 350-375 basis points, market sources said.
Also on deck for Wednesday, Autopistas Del Sol SA, an Argentine toll road company, plans to sell $380 million in a two-part debt offering via Citicorp Securities Inc.
Price talk on a $150 million seven-year tranche is 300-325 basis points over Treasuries. Talk on a $230 million tranche of 12-year debt is 362.5-387.5 basis points over Treasuries.
Polysindo International Finance Co BV, an Indonesian chemical and textile company, is also expected to sell $200 million in senior secured notes rated Ba2/BB-plus.
Price talk on the deal, which is being lead-managed by Morgan Stanley, is 312.5-337.5 basis points over Treasuries, sources said.

Finally, Compania Internacional De Telecomunicaciones SA (COINTEL), may price a $400 million two-part deal as early as Wednesday via a Goldman Sachs & Co and Merrill Lynch & Co-led syndicate, sources said.
COINTEL is the holding company for Telefonica de Argentina, the largest telephone company in Argentina.

Price talk on a $200 million U.S. dollar denominated seven-year tranche is a spread range of 250-262.5 basis points over Treasuries. Talk on a $200 million Argentine Peso-denominated seven-year tranche is expected to be 150 basis points over the spread on the U.S. dollar tranche.
